ValidationRule.description: Credit Note can only be created against the Tax Invoice
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), RecordType.Name='Credit Note', Bypass_Validation__c=false, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Invoice_No__r.Invoice_Status__c, 'Tax Invoice')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Credit Note can only be created against an invoice with 'Tax Invoice' status only.
